pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal patches with softened edge gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the neck and mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed geometries on the lower hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent (Y-shaped). Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-body but narrows towards the distal regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck line, providing a distinct textural contrast against the dark background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian figures (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal neck and shoulder region, causing localized occlusion of the underlying pelage.
